name: fal
summary: API platform for generative media models and serverless GPUs.
description: fal.ai on 21 October 2026 described a generative media inference platform: call many models through one API, deploy your own on serverless GPUs, or train on GPU clusters. No dollar rate was in that text.

pricing.label: Premium
pricing.note: Usage-based pricing is implied by the API product. Rates were not copied.

howToUse.title: Get started
howToUse.description: The homepage is a generative media platform for developers and links Get started to the login page.

howToUse.title: Pick a model
howToUse.description: The page says the gallery has 1,000+ production-ready image, video, audio, and 3D models.

howToUse.title: Call a model or deploy your own
howToUse.description: The page says to call a hosted model or deploy your own on the same platform.

howToUse.title: Use serverless GPUs
howToUse.description: Serverless GPUs and on-demand clusters are part of the same pitch. Documentation is linked from the nav.
